title: Gadget gates for one instruction
statement: Let $\kappa$ be finite, let $m,w,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $F:\kappa\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})$, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. For instruction index $i$ and instruction $\mathrm{ins}$, take the padded list of its source bits and replace each source by a copy gate referring to its tabulation source index. Append the fixed gate list for the instruction's kind, shifting every vertex index in that list by the base index for instruction $i$.
caveat: The construction uses upstream padding, source-index, fixed-gate, and base-index definitions that are not described in this request's definitions.
